label: rho v3 ladder table against the v2 tuned walks, prime ladder 2^18..2^28
description: Does building the jump table from shared ladders (rho.negation_v3, rho.plain_v3: two additions a jump, k ~ sqrt(F/2) jumps) bring S to sqrt(pi/2A)? Incumbent rho.negation_v2 with an A/A control, rho.plain beside rho.plain_v3, interleaved on six registered-search prime curves (same seed as the 2026-10-06 prime-toy challenge), 32 planted targets each. Counted GAE; local L0 host.
